input: I like cooking because I can choose fresh ingredients. My school has five buildings. My address is near a bus stop. The weather is sunny today. Choosing fresh ingredients matters to me.
question: Why do you like cooking?

key_issues.message: 回答中混入了与“为什么喜欢做饭”无关的内容：“My school has five buildings.”“My address is near a bus stop.”“The weather is sunny today.”，这些句子没有回答题目。
核心原因只有“I can choose fresh ingredients.”，但缺少具体展开，例如为什么新鲜食材对你重要、它如何影响做饭体验。
信息顺序混乱：先给出原因，再插入无关信息，最后又重复“Choosing fresh ingredients matters to me.”，导致主线不清晰。
“Choosing fresh ingredients matters to me.” 语法正确，但和前面“I can choose fresh ingredients”重复，口语中显得啰嗦。

feedback.optimization_summary: 删除了与题目无关的学校、地址和天气信息，保留用户真实原因“可以自己选择新鲜食材”。把重复的“Choosing fresh ingredients matters to me.”合并进主句，使回答更连贯、简洁。没有添加用户未提供的新理由或经历。
feedback.final_upgraded_answer: I like cooking because I can choose fresh ingredients, and that really matters to me.
feedback.reference_answer: Honestly, it's the one part of my day where I get to switch off completely. Following a recipe keeps my hands busy, so my mind stops racing about work and deadlines. I also like that it's a bit of a creative outlet — you can take whatever's in the fridge and turn it into something decent, and there's a real sense of achievement when it actually comes together. Plus, cooking for other people is my way of showing I care without having to say it out loud. It's not always relaxing, though — if I'm trying something new and it goes wrong, it can be pretty frustrating. But most nights it's the thing I look forward to.
feedback.reference_angle_summary: 独立主线：把做饭当作下班后关掉工作思绪的仪式，兼有创意出口和表达关心的方式，并承认偶尔也会翻车；示例不代表用户经历。
feedback.content_diagnosis: 原回答直接回应了“为什么喜欢做饭”，核心原因是“I can choose fresh ingredients.”，但随后加入学校建筑、地址和天气，这些内容与题目无关，属于跑题。最后一句重复了核心原因，没有增加新信息。整体内容单薄，需要补充具体细节才能达到较高分数。
feedback.structure_diagnosis: 原回答的信息顺序为：原因 → 无关信息 → 重复原因。逻辑连接缺失，无关信息打断了主线，导致听者难以抓住重点。修改后应围绕“喜欢做饭—选择新鲜食材—为什么这对我重要”展开。
feedback.optimization_advice: 建议保留“I can choose fresh ingredients”作为核心原因，并补充1–2句具体说明：例如新鲜食材如何影响味道、健康或做饭的乐趣。不要加入学校、地址、天气等无关内容。可以练习用“because”“so”“that’s why”等连接词把原因和结果串起来。

takeaway_expressions.usage_note: 可替换为 choose my own ingredients，强调自主选择。
